,CASE
	WHEN EDF.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
		AND EDF.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		AND EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
		THEN 'C'
	WHEN EDF.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
		AND EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
		THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
	WHEN EDF.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
		AND EDF.ACCT_CLS_DATE > EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		AND EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA')
		THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
	WHEN EDF.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' 
		AND EDF.ACCT_CLS_DATE > EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		AND EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
		THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
	WHEN EDF.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
		AND EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA')
		THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
END AS DEP_Account_Status
,EDD.Month_End AS MONTH_END
,ECD.ORGKEY AS ORGKEY
,CASE 
	WHEN SUBSTRING (ECD.ORGKEY, 1, 1) IN ('R','P') 
	THEN 'RETAIL'
	WHEN SUBSTRING (ECD.ORGKEY, 1, 1) IN ('C','B') 
	THEN 'CORPORATE'
	END AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM EDD
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DateSk, FullDate, Previous_Business_Day, Month_End
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD
WHERE DD.FULLDATE = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE)) EEC 
ON EDD.FullDate = EEC.FullDate
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
ON EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
LEFT JOIN DW.DEPOSITS_FACT EDF
	ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
	AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER CASA
	ON EDA.ACID = CASA.ACID
	AND EDA.BANK_ID = CASA.BANK_ID
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CASA.SCD_START_DATE AND CASA.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_TDMASTER TD
	ON EDA.ACID = TD.ACID
	AND EDA.BANK_ID = TD.BANK_ID
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN TD.SCD_START_DATE AND TD.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
	AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
	AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE EEC.FullDate IS NOT NULL




WITH PREV_DATE AS (
SELECT DateSk, FullDate, Previous_Business_Day, Month_End, Business_Day_Flag
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD
WHERE DD.FULLDATE = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE)
)
,
NEW_PREV_DATE AS (
SELECT ED.DateSk, ED.FullDate, ED.Previous_Business_Day, ED.Month_End, ED.Business_Day_Flag
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM ED
INNER JOIN PREV_DATE PD
ON ED.FULLDATE = PD.Previous_Business_Day
)

DELETE DAH
FROM EDS.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER DAH
INNER JOIN NEW_PREV_DATE EC
ON DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE = EC.Previous_Business_Day
WHERE DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE = EC.Previous_Business_Day
AND DAH.Month_End = 'N';
